_comment: First-time tips. Each fires once per player profile (user://settings.cfg, not the save) the first time EventBus.tip_moment is sent with its `when`, and never while the game is playing itself. Text is what the README says about the same thing, cut down to one card.

tips.title: Watched ground
tips.text: A band is out on this ground. The red cells are what it can see, and they move as it patrols: step onto one and it fights you right there. Trees and rock block its view, and long grass hides you.

tips.title: The road
tips.text: WASD or the arrow keys walk the land; it runs on, and the towns stand in it. M opens the map; the compass points where to go. Esc opens the menu, with How to Play in it.
tips.touch: The stick walks the land; it runs on, and the towns stand in it. Tap the small map for the big one; the compass points where to go. Menu has How to Play in it.

tips.title: Every step is time
tips.text: Each step moves the world's clock. Open gates spill, word of what you did travels, and the seasons turn whether you are ready or not.

tips.title: The wild is thickening
tips.text: Danger belongs to the place. Near an open gate bands stand thick on the ground; near a hearth the country goes quiet.

tips.title: A fight
tips.text: Fights run in real time and are on the moment they see you. Space pauses and unpauses; give orders while paused. Out of their sight, G winds up a first strike that lands before they turn. Left-click a fighter, drag a box round several, or press Tab for everyone (1 to 6 for one each); right-click to move them there or attack. Q W E R for skills.
tips.touch: Fights run in real time and are on the moment they see you. Pause on the side stops it; give orders while paused. Tap a fighter to pick them, then tap ground or an enemy to send them; a skill, then its target. Out of their sight, Strike first winds up a blow that lands before they turn.

tips.title: Facing matters
tips.text: The wedge on a token shows where it looks. Side hits deal 1.1×, back hits 1.2×. Send someone round the side of a foe who is busy with somebody else.

tips.title: Falling is usually fatal
tips.text: A downed character has a few seconds for a friend to reach them: right-click them. If nobody does, they roll their graces: a charm carried, an ally still standing, a book read, the ground they fell on. If none land, they are gone for good.
tips.touch: A downed character has a few seconds for a friend to reach them: pick a friend and tap the fallen one. If nobody does, they roll their graces: a charm carried, an ally still standing, a book read, the ground they fell on. If none land, they are gone for good.

tips.title: A place to stop
tips.text: Resting here patches everyone up. H hires whoever is drinking here, B buys the gear on the shelf, J reads the job board. The line at the bottom always says what you can do.
tips.touch: Resting here patches everyone up. The buttons above the bar hire whoever is drinking here, buy the gear on the shelf and read the job board. The line at the bottom always says what you can do.

tips.title: Inside a gate
tips.text: E beside a gate takes you in. Win a floor and you can walk away with it won, or press E again for the next, until the gate is shut. A gate left open too long breaks.
tips.touch: Act beside a gate takes you in. Win a floor and you can walk away with it won, or press Act again for the next, until the gate is shut. A gate left open too long breaks.

tips.title: A library
tips.text: Someone in the party reads what is on the shelf. Books grant knowledge, and knowledge left unused fades. The party screen (P) shows what is close to going.
tips.touch: Someone in the party reads what is on the shelf. Books grant knowledge, and knowledge left unused fades. Party on the top bar shows what is close to going.

tips.title: Home
tips.text: Nothing camps within sight of your own door, and sleeping here always patches the party up. U buys a better bed: its comfort becomes permanent extra HP.
tips.touch: Nothing camps within sight of your own door, and sleeping here always patches the party up. The bed button buys a better bed: its comfort becomes permanent extra HP.

tips.title: Level 2 is a choice
tips.text: Someone is ready to choose a path. Press P and pick their class from its card.
tips.touch: Someone is ready to choose a path. Tap Party and pick their class from its card.

tips.title: The Tower
tips.text: A hundred floors, in chapters of five, each floor paying gold. What you win up here is only yours once you walk off its step. Lose a floor and the hoard stays behind.

tips.title: An errand
tips.text: Its mark is on the map. Walk it yourself, or send a companion from the party screen's Practice page. They come back, or meet something on the road alone.

tips.title: The Adventurers Guild
tips.text: Y opens the Guild hall. Guild adventurers can muster beside you at a gate.
tips.touch: The Guild button opens the Guild hall. Guild adventurers can muster beside you at a gate.

tips.title: The season has turned
tips.text: Seasons turn every 120 steps: Lesser Green, Green, Brown and Ice. The clover by the top bar says which one you are walking in.

tips.title: Let it play itself
tips.text: Q hands the run to the game, and it walks, fights and answers for itself. T cycles the speed. Press Q again to take the party back, even mid-fight.
tips.touch: Auto on the top bar hands the run to the game, and it walks, fights and answers for itself. The speed button beside it cycles the speed. Tap Auto again to take the party back, even mid-fight.
